limits: One short CPU cohort on one laptop, with profiling; no rendered FPS, input latency, first-miss cost or general throughput guarantee.
Same fixed one-tick observer cadence in both arms; durations include unisolated caches, thermals, OS scheduling, JIT and ordinary GC.
Native step mean rises slightly; inspection improvement does not prove every simulation region improved.
No memory-growth cause, rendered observer-overhead, thirty-minute reliability, physical input, clean-install or Alpha closure.
Exact reproduction needs retained world/assets, original compiled gameplay closure, bridge/SDK closure, hostfxr and original traces; not a clean-checkout benchmark.
Original game and selected bridge SDK hashes differ; separately qualified actual consumption, not ABI-number inference.
Remaining unconditional model-cache reference scanning is a source-supported candidate, not an isolated timing cause in this measurement.
